run_attention_overhead_benchmark: run the attention overhead benchmark with a given sequence length and batch size on CUDA
run_attention_benchmark_with_fake_seqlen: run the attention benchmark using a fake max sequence length to test graph recording overhead
run_attention_benchmark_with_profiling: run the attention benchmark and export a Chrome trace for CUDA profiling analysis
run_attention_benchmark_with_custom_page: run the attention overhead benchmark with a custom page size for paged KV cache
run_attention_benchmark_with_custom_iter: run the attention benchmark with custom warmup and iteration counts for timing measurements
